action.action-desc: Mr. Larsen of Washington (for himself, Mr. Cleaver, Ms. Kamlager-Dove, Ms. Simon, Mr. Johnson of Georgia, and Mr. Thanedar) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on the Judiciary

form.official-title: To require a GAO study on State and Federal prison libraries, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Read for Reentry Act of 2026.

Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this Act, the Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct a study on libraries and library services offered in State and Federal prisons, and submit to Congress a report, that—

paragraph.text: includes a description of any library services provided in such prisons;
identifies any sources of funding for such libraries and library services;
includes the demographic information of all incarcerated individuals in State and Federal prisons that offer library services, including—
identifies the prison recidivism rate for an individual released from a State or Federal prison that offers library services;
identifies the parole compliance rate for an individual released from a State or Federal prison that offers library services;
includes a description about workforce placement for individuals released from a State or Federal prison that offers library services;

identifies the rate of disciplinary infractions (as defined by the Director of the Bureau of Prisons) involving an incarcerated individual in a State or Federal prison that offers library services; and
includes any other relevant information or findings, as determined by the Comptroller General, with respect to such libraries and library services.
